chunk: title: Canonical Product Title — Education Vertical
standard: derived (OAGIS 10.x Item + education ISBN conventions)

deviations:
  - Products carry multiple ISBNs (one per state where the title is adopted)
  - Same physical product has different ISBNs per state due to state textbook adoption processes
  - Product exists in both Salesforce (Product2 object) and QuickBooks (Item) — sync gap UC5-potential

description: >
  Canonical product/title model for K-12 educational publishers. Represents a curriculum book series
  (Student Activity Book) that carries state-specific ISBNs. Used for product catalog sync (UC5-potential)
  between Salesforce and QuickBooks. Stub — promoted to full schema when UC5 is confirmed in scope.

properties:
  productId:
    type: string
    description: Salesforce Product2 ID (system of record if SF is master)
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  qbItemId:
    type: string
    description: QuickBooks Item ID — external ID for cross-system matching
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  titleName:
    type: string
    description: Full product name (e.g. Intensified Algebra Volume 1 SAB)
    sourceSystem: both
  series:
    type: string
    description: Curriculum series (e.g. Intensified Algebra, Intensified Integrated Math)
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  gradeLevel:
    type: string
    description: Grade level target (e.g. Grade 6-8, Grade 9-10)
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  isbns:
    type: array
    description: State-specific ISBNs for this title
    items:
      type: object
      required: [isbn, state]
      properties:
        isbn:
          type: string
          description: ISBN-13 format
        state:
          type: string
          description: US state code (ISO or free-text per SF Picklist setting)
        adoptionStatus:
          type: string
          enum: [state-adopted, district-adopted, pending]
  unitPrice:
    type: number
    description: List price per unit (USD)
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  unitCost:
    type: number
    description: Cost per unit from QuickBooks
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  activeForSale:
    type: boolean
    description: Whether the title is available for new orders in the current academic year
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
